fuelConsumptionMultiplier.description: Helicopter fuel burn multiplier. 1.0 = default (about 2x a truck of similar cargo). Raise for a harsher, more realistic diesel cost; lower to make flying cheaper. Takes effect after reloading the save.

cargoCapacityMultiplier.description: Helicopter cargo capacity multiplier. 1.0 = default (40 / 90 / 180 per tier). Takes effect after reloading the save.

buildTimeMultiplier.description: Helicopter assembly time multiplier. 1.0 = default (40 / 55 / 75 s per tier). Higher = slower to build. Takes effect after reloading the save.

heliportT1PowerKw.description: Power draw of the Open Heliport T1, in kW. Takes effect after reloading the save.

heliportT2PowerKw.description: Power draw of the Open Heliport T2, in kW. Takes effect after reloading the save.
